<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tiles(fr):
    res={}
    for name,(r,c) in {'T':(50,30),'L':(55,25),'R':(55,35),'B':(60,30),'C':(55,30)}.items():
        for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
            bb=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); c0=min(p[1] for p in bb)
            if abs(r0-r)<=1 and abs(c0-c)<=1:
                res[name]=n['color']
    return res
def spin(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']>=2:
            bb=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); c0=min(p[1] for p in bb)
            if r0>=17 and c0>16: out.append((n['color'],r0,min(p[0] for p in bb),c0,max(p[1] for p in bb)))
    return sorted(out,key=lambda x:(x[3],x[4]))
seq = [ {'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':30}, {'action':'MOUSE','row':60,'col':30},
        {'action':'MOUSE','row':60,'col':30}, {'action':'DOWN'} ]
for i,a in enumerate(seq):
    r = action([a])
    print(i, tiles(history[-1].frame), spin(history[-1].frame), 'done:', r.get('done'), 'lc:', r.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
